findings.claim: The change claims retained visual evidence, but the diff does not add the referenced screenshots or Playwright trace archives.
findings.evidence: The verification text says "Three implementation screenshots and three clean-room screenshots are retained independently with their associated traces," and the JSON receipts reference paths such as `task-3-browser-graph-and-transports.png`, `clean-browser-graph-and-transports.png`, and `trace.zip`, but the diff contains no added binary artifact hunks for those files; acceptance requires recording verification evidence and browser visual evidence before archive.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the referenced screenshot and trace artifacts to the repository or remove the archive-ready claim and make the verifier regenerate and validate them as part of the checked gate.

findings.claim: Public runtime exports were added without updating the public API/skills ledgers required by the acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: The diff adds exports including `createSyncProviderRegistry`, `getDefaultSyncProviderRegistry`, `createWebSocketLoroChannel`, `encodeLoroWebSocketMessage`, `decodeLoroWebSocketMessage`, and `createLoroLoopbackNetwork`, while the acceptance criterion says to "Update `examples/coverage.json`, public API ledgers, skills, and documentation whenever this change affects their declared surface"; no public export ledger JSON is modified in the diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the relevant export refresh commands and commit the updated skills/API ledger files alongside the public export changes.

findings.claim: `useSuspenseEntity` no longer throws when called without a non-null entity id, weakening the previous invariant.
findings.evidence: The old branch explicitly threw `useSuspenseEntity requires a non-null entity id` when loading without `id`, but the new condition requires `id` before suspending and removes that error path, so `id` being null/undefined with no data and no error can fall through instead of failing closed.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore an explicit `if (!id) throw new Error(...)` path before the cache-miss suspense branch.
